title: Atlantic contract terms and the sides released
summary: Atlantic offered a hundred dollars plus session fee against royalties; he never saw royalties, and six sides were issued.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

Well, he'd come up with a hundred dollars plus session fee, you know. Yeah. But, at that time that was plenty of money, you know, I guess.
And then he'd say, did you sign a contract or anything?
Well, I'm gonna sign a contract for what I was doing, you know. Yeah.
